summary:
Enter in the agenda app now jumps to the earliest later day with an event and does nothing if none exists; the existing tests and a new test for Enter all pass.

I added an `enter` branch to the `key` task in `desk:apps:agenda` (lines 14–23), and left the help text and other keys unchanged. I put the new test in `desk:apps:enter-tests`; it uses `fixed` lines for the event text, which the app's `use` reads only inside the test world. The app itself never reads or changes pages in `desk:apps`, and no page there has a `#end` line.

files.desk:apps:agenda:
app 'Agenda'
task start()
  set events to []
  for each p in pages('calendar')
    add fields(p) to events
  done
  give {events: events, day: today()}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'right'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, 1)
  or when k is 'left'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, -1)
  or when k is 'enter'
    set best to ''
    for each e in s.events
      when e.date > s.day and (best is '' or e.date < best)
        set best to e.date
      done
    done
    when best is not ''
      set s.day to best
    done
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  title('Agenda')
  show(1, 1, s.day & ' ' & weekday(s.day))
  set rows to []
  for each e in s.events
    when e.date is s.day
      add e.time & ' ' & e.title to rows
    done
  done
  set rows to sort(rows)
  when count(rows) is 0
    show(3, 1, '(no events)')
  done
  set r to 3
  for each l in rows
    when r <= 23
      show(r, 1, l)
    done
    set r to r + 1
  done
  help('Left/Right change the day')
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'

test 'it shows the events of today, by time'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 15:00' & newline() & 'title: Dentist' & newline() & 'with: '
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 09:30' & newline() & 'title: Standup' & newline() & 'with: team'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '09:30 Standup'
  check screen_line(4) is '15:00 Dentist'
done

test 'right goes to the next day'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'right'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-02 wednesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '(no events)'
done
files.desk:apps:enter-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'
fixed n is newline()
fixed a is 'date: 2026-12-05' & n & 'time: 10:00' & n & 'title: Gym'
fixed b is 'date: 2026-12-03' & n & 'time: 09:00' & n & 'title: Run'
test 'enter jumps to the next day that has an event'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds a
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds b
launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
press 'enter'
check app_mistake() is ''
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-03 thursday'
press 'enter'
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-05 saturday'
press 'enter'
check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-05 saturday'
check screen_line(3) has '10:00'
done
